PLAN "Prenatal Strength 12-week"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain and build strength safely during pregnancy"
  GOAL secondary nutrition:
    name "Support pregnancy and maintain lean mass with appropriate macronutrients"
  GOAL cardio:
    name "Maintain cardiovascular fitness with moderate-intensity, pregnancy-safe cardio"
  GOAL core:
    name "Preserve core strength and stability with pregnancy-safe core work"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower strength + core + cardio":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Tuesday training 30m "Cardio steady + core activation":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 20x1..1 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper push/pull + core + cardio":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 6..7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Full body accessory + core + cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 rpe 6..7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Saturday training 25m "Light cardio + core mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 15x1..1 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          dead_bug 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Lower strength + core + cardio":

          cycling 8m
